title: Chat gets a voice and a simpler key flow
summary:
Chat gained audio and bring-your-own-key controls, community quests gained a fixed-reward path, and the app catalog grew in several directions at once.

The community-maintained chat app added Audio mode with model and voice choices, plus a dialog for using your own Pollen key. Clearer error messages make it easier to tell when a key needs attention. CatGPT also restored avatar-comic generation after its selfie reference expired, with sketches better matched to the comic style.

Community Quest issues now have a template spelling out the fixed Pollen reward, goal and acceptance criteria. Merged quest PRs can trigger a payout to the quest assignee; a follow-up changed recipient lookup to a stable GitHub ID so username changes do not interrupt rewards.

Twenty-one catalog PRs added community projects spanning image and video creation, coding practice, stories, games and tools in several languages. The additions include Opticode for pair-programming practice, ivLyrics for pronunciation and translation, and anyproject for sharing AI-generated sites. The README also made featured creators easier to find.

daily.title: Audio mode in chat
daily.text: Switch the chat app to Audio mode and choose an audio model and voice. [Open chat](https://chat.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Use your key in chat
daily.text: A new dialog lets you use your own Pollen key in the chat app, with clearer messages when authentication or balance needs attention. [Open chat](https://chat.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Community Quests take shape
daily.text: Community Quest issues now spell out a fixed Pollen reward, goal and acceptance criteria, with a payout path for merged contributions. [Explore the repository](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations).
